newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon jumps on GSM launch rumours.
newsitem.headline: Benefon jumps on GSM launch rumours.

text.p: Shares in Finnish mobile phone maker Benefon Oy rose sharply on Tuesday on market talk that the company would soon launch its first GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) handset, brokers said.

At 1650/1450 GMT, Benefon traded at 87.00 markka, up 8.50 markka or more than 10 percent. Trade was a lively 5.5 million markka. "There are rumours on the market that Benefon would finally launch its long expected GSM phone," a broker said.
Brokers said both domestic and foreign investors were buying Benefon shares.
Benefon has repeatedly said its GSM launch has been delayed.
